profile.title: Professional Information
profile.bio:
I like taking an idea all the way to production: designing the database, building the API, crafting the frontend and getting the app onto someone's phone.

I'm a Higher Technician in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM) and a junior Full Stack developer. I'm currently taking an in-person specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, and on my own I'm learning game development with Godot.

🔹 The project I'm proudest of: Eventvs Mérida
A mobile app that brings Mérida's cultural and leisure agenda together in one place. We built it as a team of three for our final project: a Flutter app, a Spring Boot REST API, a Supabase database, an Angular admin panel and landing page, and supporting Python scripts. Over 600 commits and deployed to production.

🔹 Windows XP-style portfolio
My portfolio recreates the Windows XP experience in the browser, built with Angular. If you want to get to know my work, start there 😉

🛠️ Stack: Java · Spring Boot · Python · Angular · Flutter/Dart · Supabase · Firebase · Git · Vercel · Render

I'm looking for my next opportunity as a Full Stack, Backend or Mobile developer, where I can contribute from day one and keep learning with a great team.

🌐 Portfolio: adrianpmdev-portfolio.vercel.app
💻 GitHub: github.com/adrianpmdev
📩 Write to me here, I reply quickly.
